newsitem.title: USA: Cypress optimistic 1997 will be good year.
newsitem.headline: Cypress optimistic 1997 will be good year.

text.p: Cypress Semiconductor Corp Tuesday said it is optimistic 1997 will be a good year for the company.
In a statement accompanying its first quarter financial results, Cypress President and Chief Executive T.J. Rodgers said bookings and billings increased in all product division during the quarter.

"We are very pleased to have recorded double-digit revenue growth this quarter, the second consecutive quarter of revenue growth since the third quarter of 1996, which we declared to be our bottom quarter in the memory-driven recession of 1996," he said. "Despite lower average selling prices in the March quarter, we increased unit volume and improved our gross margin by a point from the 33.5 percent reported last quarter to 34.6 percent."
"A continued increase in unit demand plus the momentum gained from these new products give us optimism that 1997 will be a good year," Rodgers added.
